newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas makes south Texas discovery.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas makes south Texas discovery.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said Tuesday its W.P.O.G. State Gas Unit No. 1 well had encountered a total of 158 feet of net pay in an oil and gas discovery in San Patricio County, south Texas.

Electric logs indicated nine zones of productive pay, including 71 feet of natural gas pay in the Vicksburg formation and Frio Sands, and 87 feet of oil pay in the Frio Sands, after the well was drilled to a total depth of 13,320 feet, it said.

The discovery well is located about 40 miles east of TransTexas' Agua Dulce natural gas marketing hub. TransTexas owns a 50 percent working interest in the area with Sanchez-O'Brien Oil & Gas Corp as operator, owning the remaining 50 percent working interest.
The companies expect to complete the well using a dual completion technique within one month, TransTexas said. A second well is planned to delineate the discovery area.
